```sql
WITH lines AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           ol.order_id,
           pv.id               AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           order_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS q,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS r
      FROM lines
     GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
prod_agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)          AS order_count,
           sum(q)::bigint    AS quantity,
           sum(r)            AS revenue_cents
      FROM per_order
     GROUP BY product_id
),
var_agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM lines) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pa.order_count,
       pa.quantity,
       pa.revenue_cents,
       va.variant_count
  FROM prod_agg pa
  JOIN var_agg va ON va.product_id = pa.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = pa.product_id
 ORDER BY pa.quantity DESC, pa.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure externe sort op brede rijen (p.id, o.id inclusief productkolommen) voor de twee `count(DISTINCT …)` vervalt. In de plaats daarvan komen smalle hash-aggregaties: eerst per (product, order) en per (product, variant), daarna per product met `count(*)`. De tabel `products` wordt pas na de aggregatie gejoind. `sum(q)::bigint` behoudt het oorspronkelijke type `bigint` voor `quantity`, en de waarden blijven identiek omdat alle gesommeerde kolommen NOT NULL zijn.
